name: parallel-design-exploration
title: Parallel Design Exploration
description: Standalone Open Design scenario for Claude-Design-style parallel exploration: render sibling variants inline in one persistent design document, preserve prior rounds visibly, and converge only when the user asks.

query.en: Use Parallel Design Exploration for my brief. Create ONE persistent HTML design document. Render {{variantCount}} materially different sibling variants inline in the same comparative field—no separate variant files, no iframes, and no pre-generation winner. On follow-up turns, edit that same HTML and append new rounds while keeping all earlier rounds visibly present and unchanged.
query.zh-CN: 使用 Parallel Design Exploration 处理我的设计需求。只创建一个持续存在的 HTML 设计文档，在同一个比较画布中内联渲染 {{variantCount}} 个实质不同的并行方案：不要拆成多个方案文件，不要用 iframe，也不要在生成前选赢家。后续轮次继续编辑同一个 HTML，追加新一轮，同时让之前所有轮次保持可见且不被覆盖。
